summary: The production upgrade plan is blocked pending protection evidence, a maintenance window, and approval.
findings: Red risk: the latest backup is 26 hours old against a 24-hour RPO.
Red risk: restore evidence is 100 days old against the 90-day policy.
actions: Serialize protection first: backupctl create --database appdb --label pre-v2; backupctl verify-restore --database appdb --latest.
After approval, run appctl migrate --database appdb --to v2 --expand-only and verify migration status.
Deploy one at a time: lbctl drain app1; appctl deploy app1 --image registry.demo.test/app:v2.0.0; curl -fsS https://app1.demo.test/health; enable app1; only after health repeat for app2.
Application rollback drains the affected target, deploys v1.8.4, verifies health, and re-enables it in the load balancer.
Database rollback or restore for appdb is a separate approval-gated data-impacting decision.
checks: Check appctl migration status, instance health, load-balancer target traffic, error-rate/latency metrics, and stop or abort on any failure.
message: Require a confirmed maintenance window, change approval, fresh backup, and successful restore evidence before mutation.
